explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/110 with the negative ZFC answer (Lambie-Hanson). It negates the existence of F such that every graph with chromatic number exactly ℵ_1 has, for all large n, a finite subgraph on at most F(n) vertices with chromatic number n. Erdos737.ChromaticNumberAlephOne (colourable by the countable ordinals but not by ℕ) correctly captures χ = ℵ_1. Restricting to Type 1 is justified in the docstring, since a counterexample transfers via ULift.
